stable.notes: Message a session from the Session Pet. A paperplane on each live row opens a card that names the session; Return sends into the real thread, the same routes the glasses use. A running Claude session takes it into its own window; a session mid-turn queues it and it lands when the turn ends, in the pet and in the Sessions pane. Meetings and Speakers read times as 1:02 PM; Settings, Advanced, Clock offers 24-hour.

notice.title: Message a session from the pet
notice.body: Hover a live row in the pet's RUNNING list and press the paperplane. The card names the session; Return sends. A live Claude session takes the message into its own window; a Codex or Cursor session, or a session mid-turn, queues it and it lands when the turn ends. Meeting times now read 1:02 PM; the 24-hour clock is under Settings, Advanced, Clock.
